name: Authentication Accessibility Guard
summary: Block edits that stop a password manager filling an authentication field or stop the user pasting into it.
description: Parses bounded markup and rejects changes that newly block paste on a credential field, disable its autofill, drop its autocomplete token, or add a password-manager opt-out attribute, each a documented WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.8 failure condition.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks edits that stop a password manager filling an authentication field or stop the user pasting into it; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not identify a credential field from a class, placeholder, or framework binding; only the password input type and a reserved autocomplete token are treated as evidence.
It does not report a paste block, disabled autofill, or manager opt-out that the inspected edit did not introduce.
It does not recognise every password manager's opt-out attribute, and it does not detect an alternative authentication method offered elsewhere.
It does not claim WCAG 3.3.8 conformance.

entrypoints.purpose: Block edits that stop a password manager filling an authentication field or stop the user pasting into it.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block edits that stop a password manager filling an authentication field or stop the user pasting into it without deferred work.
